text: Planning a trip is almost as exciting as the journey itself. Last summer, I travelled to Japan with two friends, and we spent weeks choosing places to visit. Experiencing new cultures was amazing, especially trying local food like fresh sushi and warm ramen. However, we sometimes faced language barriers, because most people around us didn't speak English. We learned to use simple words, pictures, and hand gestures to communicate. Although it was sometimes difficult, those moments made us laugh. Now, when I look back at our photos, I realise that these memories will stay with me forever. Travel really opens your mind and teaches you about the world.
